About: Every number README.md and the Thermal page quote, in one place. Each value's Readme text appears verbatim in both pages (tests/Ui.Tests/Examples/ThermalExamplesTests.cs), and the Category=Benchmark test re-runs the shipped setup and holds Recorded to Tolerance. Measured once on an Apple M4 (10 cores, 16 GB), macOS 27.0, the Debug build (what circuitRF's own runs use), Gmsh 4.15.2. A time is the whole run's wall clock through `circuitrf em`; memory is the process's peak resident size.

Shipped.Solver: PCG + AMG; 3 to 4 Newton steps over k(T) per point

External.Name: the thermal interface material, one-dimensional
External.Formula: T_interface = Ths + Pdiss * t / (k * A), t = 100 µm, k = 3 W/(m·K), A = 10 mm × 8 mm

Alternatives.Name: every element size × 0.7 (the setup's mesh check)
Alternatives.Mesh: 1,153,126 tetrahedra of order 1, the first sweep point

Alternatives.Name: the via field as an effective block
